note: Labelled scenarios planted in the demo dataset. This file is used ONLY by the evaluation suite and tests; the application never reads it to produce findings. Each scenario lists the finding keys (rule_id:subject) the engine is expected to produce. 'primary' keys are required for the scenario to count as detected; 'secondary' keys are acceptable additional detections caused by the same planted facts and are not counted as false positives.

scenarios.name: Seller-reported revenue overstated
scenarios.description: For 2025-06, 2025-07 and 2025-08 the seller's monthly revenue figure equals gross sales (before refunds) plus the value of cancelled orders, instead of net sales.
scenarios.records: seller_statements.period in (2025-06, 2025-07, 2025-08); orders with status='cancelled' and refunds posted in those months
scenarios.detection_logic: REV-001: |reported_revenue - net_sales| / net_sales >= 2%; variance attribution should match 'refunds posted + cancelled orders'.

scenarios.name: Refunds recorded after the original sale period
scenarios.description: 45 'goodwill' refunds against July and August orders are posted between 5 and 28 October 2025 (60-110 days after sale).
scenarios.records: refunds with reason='goodwill refund' and refund_date in 2025-10
scenarios.detection_logic: REF-002: posting month with >= 8 refunds of lag > 45 days representing >= 25% of the month's refund value.

scenarios.name: Product with unusually high return rate
scenarios.description: TEX-003 'Linen Throw - Sage' has an 18% refund probability per line (vs 4.5% for other products); 60% of its refunds carry the reason 'quality issue - pilling/shedding'.
scenarios.detection_logic: REF-001: return rate >= max(10%, 2x portfolio rate) with >= 30 units sold.

scenarios.name: Advertising understated in one seller statement
scenarios.description: The 2025-09 statement reports advertising at 55% of the platform-recorded spend.
scenarios.detection_logic: ADV-002: |reported_ad_spend - sum(channel spend)| >= 10% of recorded spend.

scenarios.name: Revenue concentrated in one product
scenarios.description: CAN-001 'Signature Saffron Candle' carries a demand weight that gives it ~28% of gross sales.
scenarios.detection_logic: CON-001: top SKU share >= 25% or top-3 share >= 50%.

scenarios.name: Declining gross margin despite growing revenue
scenarios.description: From July, unit costs recorded on order lines rise 8% (14% for candles) while prices are unchanged; order volume keeps growing.
scenarios.detection_logic: MAR-001: last-6-month gross margin at least 3pp below first-6-month margin while gross sales grew.

scenarios.name: Period of unusually heavy discounting
scenarios.description: In May 2025, 70% of orders receive a 20-25% discount (vs 25% of orders at 10% in normal months).
scenarios.records: orders with order_date in 2025-05; line_discount on order_items
scenarios.detection_logic: DSC-001: discount rate >= 12% of GMS and robust z >= 3 vs other months.

scenarios.name: Inventory shrinkage not supported by movements
scenarios.description: CER-002 month-end counts are 30 units per month lower than receipts/sales/returns support from August to December (cumulative -150).
scenarios.detection_logic: INV-001 roll-forward: |recorded - expected| >= 5 units and >= 3% of opening + receipts.

scenarios.name: Phantom stock
scenarios.description: KIT-001 month-end counts are 60 units higher than movements support from September onward (a one-off positive adjustment that persists).

scenarios.name: Legitimate seasonal spike (hard negative)
scenarios.description: November 2025 order volume is 1.9x the trend (regional sales event) with a 15% promotion on 60% of orders, advertising scaled proportionally, normal refunds and stable AOV. December is 1.3x. These must NOT be raised as suspected risks.
scenarios.detection_logic: SEA-001 should classify the spike as a seasonal observation (severity info). Any REV/REF/DSC finding keyed to 2025-11 would be a false positive.

scenarios.name: Supplier cost not reflected in recorded unit cost
scenarios.description: Supplier receipts for DEC-001 from September are priced 15% above the unit cost still recorded on order lines (stale standard cost).
scenarios.records: supplier_receipts for DEC-001 with received_date >= 2025-09-01; order_items.unit_cost for DEC-001
scenarios.detection_logic: INV-003: |receipt unit cost - avg recorded unit cost in the same month| >= 5%.

known_clean.description: Facts that are deliberately clean so the engine should not raise findings on them.
items: Seller-reported revenue in all months other than Jun-Aug is within +/-0.25% of net sales.
Seller-reported advertising in all months other than Sep is within +/-1% of recorded spend.
No product other than TEX-003 has an elevated refund probability.
Inventory counts for all SKUs other than CER-002 and KIT-001 reconcile exactly to movements.
Supplier receipt costs for all SKUs other than DEC-001 equal the recorded unit cost in the same month.
